# VerbalPlanet

> VerbalPlanet is an online language learning platform connecting students with native-speaking tutors for one-on-one lessons via Zoom and Teams, featuring CEFR-based progress tracking and personalized feedback.

The platform offers live conversation practice and structured language lessons across multiple languages including German, Icelandic, and Korean. VerbalPlanet emphasizes native speaker instruction, individualized learning paths, and comprehensive analytics aligned with the Common European Framework of References for Languages (CEFR) standards.

## Key Topics

- Native-speaking tutors
- One-on-one online lessons
- Zoom and Teams integration
- CEFR (Common European Framework of References for Languages)
- Live conversation practice
- Progress tracking and analytics
- Tutor feedback
- Language assessment
- Personalized language learning
- Online tutoring platform
- Multiple language offerings
- Flexible scheduling
- Native speakers

## Platform Overview

- [Benefits of Online Language Lessons](https://www.verbalplanet.com/benefits.asp): Benefits of Verbalplanet's online language lessons with native tutors
- [Lesson Analytics and Feedback](https://www.verbalplanet.com/analytics.asp): CEFR-based lesson analytics and tutor feedback for progress tracking

## Language Programs

- [Learn German Online](https://www.verbalplanet.com/de/learn-german.asp): German language lessons via Zoom/Teams with native speakers
- [Icelandic Conversation Practice](https://www.verbalplanet.com/learn-icelandic/icelandic-conversation-online.asp): Icelandic conversation practice with native speakers via Zoom/Teams
- [Korean Conversation Practice](https://www.verbalplanet.com/learn-korean/korean-conversation-online.asp): Korean conversation lessons with native speakers via Zoom/Teams
